spoilers.lesson: A bridge network is the default Docker network. Containers on the same user-defined bridge reach each other by name through Docker's embedded DNS. Containers on the default bridge must use IP addresses. Publishing a port with -p maps a host port to a container port. Host networking removes network isolation. Overlay networks connect containers across hosts.
graded: How do containers on a user-defined bridge reach each other?
Which flag publishes a container port to the host?

spoilers.lesson: The Calvin cycle runs in the stroma. Rubisco fixes carbon dioxide onto RuBP. Three turns of the cycle produce one molecule of G3P. ATP and NADPH from the light reactions power the reduction phase. RuBP is regenerated so the cycle can continue.
graded: Where does the Calvin cycle take place?
Which enzyme fixes carbon dioxide onto RuBP?
How many turns of the cycle produce one molecule of G3P?

document.name: field-notes.pdf
pages:
Field notes, part one
The Harlow Institute survey of 1987 measured the rare moss Bryum aldebaran at 41 sites. Its spores mature only below 6 degrees Celsius.

Field notes, part two
Dr. Imre Voss named the pigment veridion after finding it in 112 samples. Veridion absorbs light at a wavelength of 487 nanometres.

Field notes, part three
The Ostrava protocol requires seeds to be stored for 19 days in a sealed jar with 3 grams of silica gel.

grounded.lesson: Field researchers record where rare plants grow and how their seeds and pigments behave, so that others can repeat their work.
